subject: MAMAS Mutual Aid Operations and Holiday Support
overview: Representatives discussed the mission and organizational structure of MAMAS Mutual Aid Medford and Somerville. The meeting focused on current community needs for the holiday season and various ways for residents to donate or volunteer.

items.title: History and Mission of MAMAS
items.summary: Madison Lewis explained that the collective formed during the pandemic to facilitate community resource sharing based on the principle that everyone has something to give and something they need.

items.title: Organizational Structure and Neighborhood Pods
items.summary: The organization operates through a horizontal model featuring hyper-local neighborhood pods and specialized working groups for tasks such as food delivery and financial coordination.

items.title: Current Community Needs and Clothing Drive
items.summary: Lewis reported a significant increase in financial and food insecurity and noted that the organization is currently prioritizing a winter clothing drive.

items.title: Donation and Volunteer Procedures
items.summary: Residents can get involved by contacting the hotline or website, with options to donate funds via electronic platforms or provide direct support like shopping for other families.

items.title: Fund Distribution and Community Education
items.summary: Financial support is distributed based on trust to cover basic living expenses like rent and food, and the group also hosts free community learning classes.
